title: The Third Rare Relic
summary: Surrounded by the phantom heralds of the Three Demon Lords, Ha-Jun fuses the Fang of Abyss and Chains of Ruin in combat, mastering the complete triad of Rare Relics.

panels.shot: three 500-foot demon lord phantoms in sky wide shot
panels.action: Three titanic demonic faces loom in the cosmic black clouds over the floating island: Iron, Shadow, and Void.
panels.prose_en: Three titanic demonic faces loom in the cosmic black clouds over the floating island: Iron, Shadow, and Void.
panels.prose_hi: Tairte dweep par brahmandiya kale baadalon mein teen titanic shaitani demonic chehre mandrate han: lauh, chhaya aur shunya.

panels.shot: demon lord malgath voice booming like thunder
panels.action: Lord Malgath's horned iron visage speaks: 'The mortal child who broke my gates... Hand over the relics and your death will be swift.'

dialogue.speaker: malgath
dialogue.text: JHUK JAO, MORTAL INSECT! RELICS KO DEMON KINGS KE HAWALE KARO!

panels.prose_en: Lord Malgath's horned iron visage speaks: 'The mortal child who broke my gates... Hand over the relics and your death will be swift.'.
panels.prose_hi: Lord Malgath ka seeng wala lohe ka drishya kehta hai: 'vah nashwar baccha jisne mere dwar tod die... avsheshon ko saunp do aur tumhari mrityu sheeghra hogi.'

panels.shot: demon lord valac shadows creeping across the ground
panels.action: Lord Valac's shadow tendrils slither across the crystal grass like living ink, trying to trap Ha-Jun's boots.
panels.prose_en: Lord Valac's shadow tendrils slither across the crystal grass like living ink, trying to trap Ha-Jun's boots.
panels.prose_hi: Lord valack ki chhaya tendril jeevit syahi ki tarah crystal ghas par fisalti hai, Ha-Jun ke jooton ko phansane ki koshish karti hai.

panels.shot: queen lilith voice whispering in thousand echoes
panels.action: Queen Lilith's masked void face whispers seductive poison: 'Join us, young Sovereign... Rule beside us instead of dying alone.'

dialogue.speaker: lilith
dialogue.text: Tumhare bhai ko hum eternal youth denge... Bas Crown ka rasta humein de do.

panels.prose_en: Queen Lilith's masked void face whispers seductive poison: 'Join us, young Sovereign... Rule beside us instead of dying alone.'.
panels.prose_hi: Rani lilith ka nakabposh shunya chehra mohak jahar fusfusata hai: 'hamare saath juden, yuva samprabhu... akele marne ke bajay hamare saath shasan karen.'

panels.shot: tae-jun shouting from behind ha-jun
panels.action: Tae-Jun shouts with burning fury: 'Unki baat mat sunna, Ha-Jun! Yeh sab jhooth bolte hain!'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Unhone saari promises todi hain! Inhe sirf tumhari power chahiye!

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun shouts with burning fury: 'Unki baat mat sunna, Ha-Jun! Yeh sab jhooth bolte hain!'.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun jalte hue gusse se chillata hai: 'unki baat mat sunna, Ha-Jun! yeh sab jhooth bolte han!'.

panels.shot: ha-jun smiling with razor-sharp contempt
panels.action: Ha-Jun tilts his chin upward, his dual-ringed eyes and cosmic galaxy eye shining with sovereign scorn.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Rule beside you? Heh. First Sovereign ke killers ke saath baithne ka mujhe koi shauq nahi hai.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun tilts his chin upward, his dual-ringed eyes and cosmic galaxy eye shining with sovereign scorn.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun apni thuddi ko upar ki or jhukata hai, uski dohri-anguthi wali aankhen aur brahmandiya akashganga ki aankhen samprabhu tiraskar se chamakti han.

panels.shot: malgath phantom roaring in insulted fury
panels.action: Malgath's iron visage roars: 'INSOLENT BRAT! SHADOW LEGION, ERASE HIM!'
panels.prose_en: Malgath's iron visage roars: 'INSOLENT BRAT! SHADOW LEGION, ERASE HIM!'.
panels.prose_hi: Malgath ki lauh drishti dahadti hai: 'dheeth ladka! chhaya sena, use mita do!'

panels.shot: hundreds of shadow phantom assassins dropping from sky
panels.action: From Valac's dark clouds, five hundred elite Shadow Assassins in bone masks dive like a black meteor shower.
panels.prose_en: From Valac's dark clouds, five hundred elite Shadow Assassins in bone masks dive like a black meteor shower.
panels.prose_hi: Valack ke kale baadalon se, haddi ke mukhaute mein paanch sau kulin chhaya hatyare kale ulka bauchhar ki tarah gota lagate han.

panels.shot: ha-jun stepping forward with chains of ruin uncoiling
panels.action: Ha-Jun unspools the heavy black chains from his torso, spinning them in a 20-meter perimeter circle.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun unspools the heavy black chains from his torso, spinning them in a 20-meter perimeter circle.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun apne dhad se bhari kali janjeeron ko kholta hai, aur unhen 20-meter paridhi circle mein ghumata hai.

panels.shot: activating 20x gravity field within perimeter
panels.action: The moment the chains touch the ground, a localized 20x gravity field crushes everything within 20 meters.
panels.prose_en: The moment the chains touch the ground, a localized 20x gravity field crushes everything within 20 meters.
panels.prose_hi: Jis kshan janjeeren jameen ko chhuti han, ek sthaniya 20x gurutvakarshan kshetra 20 meter ke bhitar sab kuch kuchal deta hai.

panels.shot: first hundred shadow assassins slammed to earth
panels.action: The first hundred diving assassins are caught in the gravity well, slammed flat into the moss like pancakes.
panels.prose_en: The first hundred diving assassins are caught in the gravity well, slammed flat into the moss like pancakes.
panels.prose_hi: Pahle sau gotakhor hatyaron ko gurutvakarshan kuen mein pakad liya jata hai aur pancake ki tarah kai mein patak diya jata hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun drawing fang of abyss in right hand
panels.action: In his right hand: the spatial void dagger; in his left hand: the master gravity chain link.
panels.prose_en: In his right hand: the spatial void dagger; in his left hand: the master gravity chain link.
panels.prose_hi: Uske dahine haath men: sthanik shunya khanjar; unke baen haath men: master gravity chain link.

panels.shot: ha-jun launching chain with dagger attached to tip
panels.action: Ha-Jun loops the void dagger onto the end of the chain, hurling it like a devastating kusarigama.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun loops the void dagger onto the end of the chain, hurling it like a devastating kusarigama.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ne shrinkhala ke ant mein shunya khanjar ko ghumaya, aur ise vinashkari kusarigma ki tarah fenk diya.

panels.shot: spinning void scythe cutting dimensional rifts
panels.action: The spinning dagger at the end of the chain slices circular tears through space itself 360 degrees around him.
panels.prose_en: The spinning dagger at the end of the chain slices circular tears through space itself 360 degrees around him.
panels.prose_hi: Shrinkhla ke ant mein ghumta hua khanjar uske charon or 360 degree tak antriksh mein golakar cheera lagata hai.

panels.shot: three hundred shadow assassins bisected in midair
panels.action: The spatial chain scythe shreds through three hundred shadow assassins in three seconds, erasing them into smoke.
panels.prose_en: The spatial chain scythe shreds through three hundred shadow assassins in three seconds, erasing them into smoke.
panels.prose_hi: Sthanik shrinkhala daranti teen second mein teen sau chhaya hatyaron ko kaatati hai, aur unhen dhuen mein mita deti hai.

panels.shot: kuro swooping down with violet flame breath
panels.action: Kuro bathes the remaining ground forces in violet hellfire, clearing every last assassin from the island.
panels.prose_en: Kuro bathes the remaining ground forces in violet hellfire, clearing every last assassin from the island.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ne shesh jamini balon ko baingani narkankaal mein nahlaya, aur dweep se har aakhiri hatyare ka safaya kar diya.

panels.shot: the island meadow cleared of all enemy forces
panels.action: In under thirty seconds, the entire 500-assassin legion is completely eradicated; silence returns.
panels.prose_en: In under thirty seconds, the entire 500-assassin legion is completely eradicated; silence returns.
panels.prose_hi: Tis second se bhi kam samay men, 500-hatyaron ki puri sena puri tarah se nasht ho gai; sannata laut aata hai.

panels.shot: the three demon lord phantoms flickering in shock
panels.action: The three titanic phantoms flicker, their smug superiority replaced with genuine, terrifying apprehension.

dialogue.speaker: valac
dialogue.text: Chains of Ruin aur Fang of Abyss ko ek saath link kar diya...? He mastered two rare relics simultaneously?!

panels.prose_en: The three titanic phantoms flicker, their smug superiority replaced with genuine, terrifying apprehension.
panels.prose_hi: Teen titanic pret timtimate han, unki atmasantusht shreshthata ki jagah vastvik, bhayanak aashanka ne le lee hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun recalling the chain with a sharp snap
panels.action: Ha-Jun snaps the chain back into his hand, the void dagger locking seamlessly into his palm.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun snaps the chain back into his hand, the void dagger locking seamlessly into his palm.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ne chain ko wapas apne haath mein khinch liya, khali khanjar uski hatheli mein nirbaadh roop se lock ho gaya.

panels.shot: ha-jun looking up at the sky phantoms
panels.action: Ha-Jun points the Fang of Abyss directly at Malgath's 500-foot eye in the clouds.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Yeh tumhara best tha? Phantoms bhejna band karo aur khud aao.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun points the Fang of Abyss directly at Malgath's 500-foot eye in the clouds.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun baadalon mein sidhe Malgath ki 500 foot ki aankh par fang off abis ko ingit karta hai.

panels.shot: lilith phantom narrowing eyes with venomous hatred
panels.action: Queen Lilith's masked phantom hisses: 'You are walking to your own funeral, boy. The Crown will destroy you.'

dialogue.speaker: lilith
dialogue.text: The Fallen Throne will become your tomb!

panels.prose_en: Queen Lilith's masked phantom hisses: 'You are walking to your own funeral, boy. The Crown will destroy you.'.
panels.prose_hi: Rani lilith ka nakabposh pret fusfusata hai: 'tum apne antim sanskar ke liye chal rahe ho, ladke. taj tumhe nasht kar dega.'

panels.shot: three phantoms dissolving back into storm clouds
panels.action: The three colossal demonic avatars dissolve into swirling black clouds, leaving the twin moons glowing again.
panels.prose_en: The three colossal demonic avatars dissolve into swirling black clouds, leaving the twin moons glowing again.
panels.prose_hi: Teen vishal shaitani demonic avtar ghumte hue kale baadalon mein vilin ho jaate han, jisse judwan chandrama phir se chamakne lagte han.

panels.shot: dawn sunlight of the demon realm breaking through
panels.action: The black clouds part; ethereal violet morning light bathes the floating crystal island once more.
panels.prose_en: The black clouds part; ethereal violet morning light bathes the floating crystal island once more.
panels.prose_hi: Kale badal chhant jaate han; alaukik baingani subah ki roshni tairte crystal dweep ko ek baar phir se nahla deti hai.

panels.shot: tae-jun stepping up beside ha-jun smiling proudly
panels.action: Tae-Jun claps Ha-Jun's shoulder firmly, laughing with tears of pure, proud joy.

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Hahahahaha! Unke 500 elite soldiers ko 30 second mein khatam kar diya! Incredible, Ha-Jun!

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun claps Ha-Jun's shoulder firmly, laughing with tears of pure, proud joy.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun Ha-Jun ke kandhe par majbuti se taali bajata hai, shuddh, garvit khushi ke aansuon ke saath hansta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun smiling warmly at his brother
panels.action: Ha-Jun's battle intensity melts away, returning to the gentle younger brother: 'Aapse seekha tha, Bhai.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Aapne hi toh sikhaya tha ki bullies ke saamne kabhi jhukna nahi chahiye.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's battle intensity melts away, returning to the gentle younger brother: 'Aapse seekha tha, Bhai.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ki ladai ki tivrata kam ho jaati hai, aur wah saumya chhote bhai ke paas laut aata hai: 'aapse seekha tha, bhai.'

panels.shot: kuro landing on a rock between them
panels.action: Kuro nods approvingly: 'Ab rasta clear hai. Rare Relics ka triad complete ho chuka hai.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Agla stop: The Sovereign Citadel of the Fallen Throne. Wahan Legendary Crown hamara intezaar kar raha hai.

panels.prose_en: Kuro nods approvingly: 'Ab rasta clear hai. Rare Relics ka triad complete ho chuka hai.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ne swikruti mein sir hilaya: 'ab rasta saaf hai. 'durlbh avsheshon ka tray pura ho chuka hai.'

panels.shot: tae-jun pointing toward north horizon
panels.action: Tae-Jun points toward a colossal jagged mountain peak shrouded in lightning ten miles north.

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Wahan... Mount Obsidian ke apex par The Fallen Throne hai.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun points toward a colossal jagged mountain peak shrouded in lightning ten miles north.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun das meal uttar mein bijli se ghiri ek vishal dantedar parvat choti ki or ishara karta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun looking toward the distant mountain
panels.action: Ha-Jun's Eye of the Night pierces the clouds, spotting the golden-violet glow of the ancient throne.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's Eye of the Night pierces the clouds, spotting the golden-violet glow of the ancient throne.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ki raat ki aankh baadalon ko bhedati hai, aur prachin sinhasan ki sunhari-bangni chamak ko dekhti hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun expanding his shadow wings wide
panels.action: Ha-Jun extends his wings, offering his back to Tae-Jun once more.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Chaliye, Bhai. Apne Sovereign Crown ko lene chalte hain.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun extends his wings, offering his back to Tae-Jun once more.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun apne pankh failata hai aur ek baar phir apni peeth Tae-Jun ki or karta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun and tae-jun taking flight toward mount obsidian
panels.action: Ha-Jun and Tae-Jun rocket into the violet morning sky toward Mount Obsidian, twin moons shining behind them.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Throne par chahe koi bhi baitha ho... Ab yeh kahani mere terms par khatam hogi.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun and Tae-Jun rocket into the violet morning sky toward Mount Obsidian, twin moons shining behind them.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun aur Tae-Jun baingani subah ke aakash mein mount obsidian ki or rocket karte han, unke peeche judwan chandrama chamak rahe han.
